# Word VML watermarks

`watermarks.docx` is generated by `make-fixture.mjs` from the XML in `fixture.js`, written for this
project in the shape Word gives a document with Design > Watermark (ECMA-376 Part 4 §14.1 VML,
Part 1 §17.3.3.19 `w:pict`): the default header holds a text watermark (`PowerPlusWaterMarkObject`,
a `v:textpath` "CONFIDENTIAL" in silver at 50 % opacity, turned 315°, centred on the margins) beside
its own text; the first-page header holds a picture watermark (`WordPictureWatermark`, a 40 × 20 PNG
washed out with `gain`/`blacklevel`). No other editor produced or saved the file.
